name: Meenakshi Chaudhary
bio:
Meenakshi Chaudhary (born March 5, 1997) is an Indian actress, model, and beauty pageant titleholder who works primarily in Telugu and Tamil cinema. She was crowned Femina Miss India Grand International 2018 and finished as the first runner-up at Miss Grand International 2018.

Chaudhary made her acting debut in the web series Out of Love (2019) and later appeared as a lead in the Telugu film Ichata Vahanamulu Niluparadu (2021). She also acted in Khiladi (2022), HIT: The Second Case (2022), and made her Tamil film debut with Kolai (2023). Her subsequent film credits include Guntur Kaaram (2024), The Greatest of All Time (2024), Lucky Baskhar (2024), and Sankranthiki Vasthunam (2025).

credits.title: Vrushakarma
credits.overview: In a desperate quest to decode ancient cave carvings, a treasure hunter hungry for untold riches, an obsessed archaeologist, and a devoted history student race against time to unravel a prophecy tied to royal lineage and the impending apocalypse, confronting the forces of destiny and evil along the way.

credits.title: Anaganaga Oka Raju
credits.overview: A lazy, entitled brat who wants to lead an easy life is in for a rude shock that changes the course of his life.

credits.title: Sankranthiki Vasthunam
credits.overview: When a renowned tech entrepreneur is kidnapped upon returning to India, a police officer recruits her ex-boyfriend, a former cop now living a quiet family life, to assist in the rescue mission.

credits.title: Mechanic Rocky
credits.overview: Rakesh, a happy-go-lucky young mechanic, must take on the ruthless land grabber Rankireddy to save his beloved ancestral car garage, uncovering unexpected truths.

credits.title: Matka
credits.overview: Set between the years 1958 and 1982, Matka tells the story of Vasu, who rises from poverty to create a powerful gambling empire in India, ultimately leading the nation into a battle with the government. Based on real events, the tale explores themes of love, moral choices, and the consequences of ambition.

credits.title: Lucky Baskhar
credits.overview: A middle-class bank clerk who longs to trade stability for adventure gets more than he bargained for when he unexpectedly becomes a wealthy man.

credits.title: The Greatest of All Time
credits.overview: A once decorated member of the Special Anti-Terrorism Squad (SATS) is called back into action by his former colleagues for an important mission, setting him on a dangerous collision course with his own past.

credits.title: Singapore Saloon
credits.overview: In a village, friends Kathir and Basheer have big dreams. Inspired by Sacha, the owner of a local hairdressing salon, Kathir decides to become a hairdresser.

credits.title: Guntur Kaaram
credits.overview: Years after his mother left him and remarried, Ramana is asked to sign documents denying any relations with his mother, but he refuses and demands answer to why his mother left him.

credits.title: Kolai
credits.overview: When a famous model gets killed, a smart detective comes to investigate when he realizes this incident calls him to a mystery.

credits.title: HIT: The 2nd Case
credits.overview: Krishna Dev aka KD, a laidback cop working in Andhra Pradesh State HIT, takes on a gruesome murder case. As KD unravels the layers of the crime, the stakes rise unbelievably high and the threat comes unusually close.

credits.title: Khiladi
credits.overview: Mohan Gandhi is a wanted criminal who’s serving time for a crime he might or might not have committed. With large sums of money, lies and deceit involved, who is he really?

credits.title: Ichata Vahanamulu Nilupa Radu
credits.overview: A young man working in an architecture firm falls for his intern. As romance blossoms, in a bid to surprise her, he accidentally enters a crime scene. How he gets out of being framed for it forms the tale.

credits.title: Upstarts
credits.overview: Hoping to do good while making millions, three college graduates create a startup. But as business begins to flourish, their own bond starts to fray.
